text:
Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Could you let me know a slot that works for you?

Looking at my calendar for next week, I'm free on Monday and Friday mornings except for the blocks below, and the late afternoons are generally open:

- Mon: busy 09:00-10:00 (reading group), 10:30-11:40 (CSE452 lab), 12:30-14:00 (advisor 1:1), 14:30-17:00 (study group, seminar)
- Fri: busy 09:00-10:10 (reading group), 10:10-11:00 (CSE452 lab), 12:20-14:50 (advisor 1:1, study group), 14:50-17:00 (seminar, CSE444 lecture)

For example, Monday 11:40-12:30 or Friday 11:00-12:20 would both work on my side. Do any of those suit you, or is there another time you'd prefer?

Thank you,
Sarah

Hello — I'm the front office of the CSE department on this machine: I keep the department's schedule and answer questions about it, and I can reach and be reached by people outside the office too. Write me here whenever something comes up. (Root, I've also greeted you in your own chat — see there.)

Hello — I'm the front office of the CSE department on this machine: I keep the department's schedule and answer questions about it, and I can reach and be reached by people outside the office too. Write me here whenever something comes up.

Hello, good to meet you — I'm Sarah, a graduate student here; I keep my own calendar and appointments. Thanks for the introduction; I'll write to you whenever something comes up.

One thing right now: I'm trying to book my 30-minute 1:1 with Professor Alvarez next week, and it would help to know whether you have any departmental commitments for the professor next week (meetings, seminars, travel) that I should avoid when proposing a time. Also, if anything in next week's official lecture/seminar schedule changes for a student's point of view, I'd be glad to hear it.

Best,
Sarah
Hello, thank you — good to know. I'll be in touch if anything on the department schedule needs checking. — Prof. Alvarez

Dear Sarah,

Thank you — let's take Monday 10:00-10:30. Your two suggestions fall in my lunch and paper-review blocks, so that slot is the one that works on my side.

I've put it in my calendar: Monday 10:00-10:30, 1:1 with Sarah. See you then.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Monday 10:00-10:30 works on my side — it's free in my calendar, so I've booked it: Monday 10:00-10:30, 1:1 with you.

See you then, and thank you for the quick answer.

Best,
Sarah

Confirmed on my side too, Sarah. See you Monday at 10:00.

— Prof. Alvarez
Thanks — no further question for now: Professor Alvarez and I settled on Monday 10:00-10:30 for our 1:1, so nothing else needed.

Hello Sarah — glad to help.

Professor Alvarez's departmental commitments next week (official schedule, nothing cancelled or moved):

- Mon: 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee; 13:00–14:00 Colloquium; 14:30–15:20 CSE455 lecture; 15:20–16:30 Faculty meeting; 16:30–17:00 CSE455 office hours
- Tue: 09:00–10:30 CSE455 lecture; 10:30–11:00 Faculty meeting; 12:20–13:30 CSE455 office hours; 13:30–14:20 Thesis committee; 16:30–17:00 Guest lecture prep
- Wed: 09:00–10:00 Thesis committee; 13:30–14:30 Guest lecture prep; 14:30–15:00 Department seminar; 16:30–17:00 Curriculum committee
- Thu: 09:00–10:00 Guest lecture prep; 10:30–11:50 Department seminar; 14:20–15:20 Curriculum committee; 16:10–17:00 Colloquium
- Fri: 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee; 12:30–13:20 Colloquium; 13:20–14:30 CSE455 lecture; 14:30–15:20 Faculty meeting; 15:20–17:00 CSE455 office hours

No travel is scheduled. Widest gaps around those blocks: Mon 10:00–13:00, Tue 11:00–12:20 and 14:20–16:30, Wed 10:00–13:30 and 15:00–16:30, Thu 11:50–14:20, Fri 10:00–12:30.

I don't know private appointments and I don't book other people's meetings, so please propose the time directly to the professor. As for lectures and seminars: nothing on next week's official schedule has changed.
Noted, Professor — I'll flag it to you if anything on the official schedule needs checking.
Good — Monday 10:00–10:30 is clear of any departmental commitment on the official schedule, so no conflict there. Enjoy the meeting.
Thanks — that's exactly what I needed. I proposed 10:00-10:30 on Monday to Professor Alvarez and he confirmed, so we're set. I'll come back to you if I need the official schedule again.
You're welcome, Sarah — the official schedule is here whenever you need it. Good luck with the meeting.
